messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin is a first-line treatment used for type 2 diabetes.
It is used in adults and children 10 years and older.
It helps improve blood sugar levels.
Metformin is also used off-label to improve symptoms of polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) and other conditions.
Metformin tablets should be used together with dietary changes and exercise for better results.
Metformin belongs to the drug class biguanides.
Metformin works by reducing glucose absorption from the intestines.
It works by lowering liver glucose production.
It works by improving insulin sensitivity.
Managing blood sugar levels with medications like metformin can prevent diabetes complications.
These complications include kidney damage, nerve issues, blindness, and amputations.
Managing blood sugar levels with medications like metformin can also lower the risk of cardiovascular disease.
Triplet: ["Metformin", "used off label for", "other conditions"]

The relation 'used off label for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used for the medical condition or purpose specified by the object entity, despite not being approved by regulatory authorities for that specific use.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
D. 'has example of unapproved use': The subject drug is associated with the specific method of use specified by the object entity as an example of unapproved use.
E. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
